Friendzy / Classic party games / The Compliment Chain

How to play The Compliment Chain

End the night on a high note A warm, simple game. Each person gives the next a genuine, specific compliment — and it passes around the circle. Not just 'you're nice.' Real ones only.

3–10 players~10 minWarm & GenuineSocial & discussion games🚗 Works in the car

How to play

  1. Sit in a circle.
  2. One person gives the person next to them a genuine, specific compliment.
  3. That person says 'thank you', then gives the next person their compliment.
  4. Keep the chain going until it reaches back to the first person.
  5. No deflecting — you must accept the compliment fully.

Example round

  • 'You always make people feel included when you walk into a room.'
  • 'Your laugh is genuinely infectious — I laugh harder because you're laughing.'
  • 'You give the most thoughtful advice without making people feel judged.'

Tips

  • Specific compliments hit harder than generic ones. 'You're kind' vs 'You remembered my coffee order for 3 months straight.'
  • Great closer for a long game night — ends the evening on warmth.
